name: Guild Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the north and south. There is a
desc3: steady stream of people here, mostly heading north towards the
desc4: Adventurer's Guild. The Guild is prospering in these rough times, as
desc5: they train adventurers and support their ventures into the overrun
desc6: slums. You can see the enormous building dominating the east side of
desc7: the street. To the west a sign saying "Colin's Maces" hangs on a shop.
